Our dentists

Great care starts with great people.

Get to know the team behind your smile.

Request an appointment

Dr. Zack Mekouar

DDS | Lead Dentist

Dr. Mekouar earned his DDS at New York University and completed postgraduate training in orthodontics. He brings more than 15 years of dental experience to his care.

Dr. Afsaneh Rangiani

DDS, PhD | Orthodontist

Dr. Rangiani is an orthodontist and scientist with a master's in dental sciences and an orthodontics certificate from the University of Connecticut, and a PhD in oral biology.

Dr. Gia Duong

DMD | Pediatric Dentist

Dr. Gia received his dental degree from the University of Pennsylvania and his pediatric dentistry certificate from Children's Hospital of Michigan. He loves making visits positive for children and their families.

Good to know

Questions? We're here to help.

Everything you need to feel a little more at home before your visit.

Request an appointment
Are you accepting new patients?

Yes. Russell Branch Dental welcomes new patients of all ages. Call or use the online booking link to get started.

What can I expect at my first visit?

Your dental team will discuss your concerns, review your oral health, and explain any recommended next steps.

Can I schedule a cleaning as a new patient?

Contact our team to discuss the right first appointment for your needs, including an exam and cleaning.

Do you see patients of all ages?

Yes. Our practice welcomes new patients of all ages.

Where is your Leesburg office?

We are located at 135 Robinson Mill Plaza SE, Unit 108, Leesburg, VA 20175.

Do you offer financing?

The practice offers financing options through CareCredit and Sunbit. Contact our team for details and eligibility.
